statement: For the actual negative basis X1,...,X7 of F24 and positive basis Yi=B_+(Xi) transported through the explicit F23 based isomorphism, every continuous rho:V_sign->Aff_1(k) over every finite field has equal images of mathcal K_sign and R_sign on the precise scalar-character locus chi(Y1)=chi(Y4)=chi(Y5)=chi(Y6)=1 and chi(Y2)chi(Y3)chi(Y7)=1. In the unequal-field case chi=(1,s,t,1,1,1,(st)^-1), k1=F_p(st)<k0=F_p(s,t), the summed H1 restriction for the m distinct k1-Frobenius conjugates is injective; the cocycle kernel is exactly the principal tuples whose parameters sum to zero, of dimension m-1 on 7m columns, giving rank 6m+1. All characteristics, finite extension degrees and larger original coefficient fields are included.

notes: The field identities k0=k1(s)=k1(t) prove all determinant factors nonzero in the remaining class, including characteristic two. The five actual additive source commutators force an essential one-dimensional submodule. The actual seed a=u_(cross_4_-1_1), source B1=old_1_0, and character-one elements B1^r(B1(a)a^-1) give evaluations s^(r+1)(st-1).
